Container.Name: Folevi-Server
Container.Overview: Your own Folevi server (Beta): notes, tasks and files for your family or team, used from the normal Folevi apps on Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android and the web. Open the WebUI to create the owner account. Prefer no containers? Install the Folevi Server plugin instead.
Container.Requires: 2 GB of free memory (4 GB recommended).

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: The Folevi Server web and app port.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Used once Folevi Server has a certificate.

Config.Name: Run as user id
Config.Description: Folevi Server starts as root only to set the data folder owner, then runs as this user (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everyone's notes, files and backups. A pool path (for example /mnt/cache/appdata/folevi) is best for the database.
